text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black managed to power her way
past the
finish line. I rush out to meet
her.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much, Trainer! Just listen
to them
chant!
choice_data_list: よくやったぞ、キタサン！
よくやったよ、キタサン！

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: KI-TA-SAN! KI-TA-SAN!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
It feels like we've finally made it. All the
goals,
the fame, and the achievements
we've been
chasing after are finally in
sight!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black has run against the world
and
successfully represented her country
as Japan's
clutch captain.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Kita! Kita!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Dia! Did you see me out there?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course. Um... I noticed something
halfway
through the race, but...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Did you lose a cleat? I could have sworn
I saw it
coming off...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... You saw it happen, huh? It felt
weird
running with only one for half the
race, but, well...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
That's racing for you. No matter what
happens,
you can't panic because the
race must go on!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I get the job done, no matter what
comes up!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She has become the living definition of

resolution. With this, we're finally ready
for the
showdown at the end of the year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That night, the two visit a place full of
memories.
They stop by the special
place where they first
promised to run
together.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
It's finally happening, Dia... What we've
always
dreamed about...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes. We're finally going to run in the
Arima Kinen.
Remember how we joined
hands like sisters and
swore on it?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Sisters... I've been trying my best to be a
good
older sister to you, but I wonder...
Did I do a
good enough job?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Because when I think back on it...

text_block_list.name: Young Dia
text_block_list.text:
Kita! Look, look! I built that block castle
you
showed me how to make!

text_block_list.name: Young Kitasan
text_block_list.text:
You did? Already? It took me forever to
get it to
stay up, but you got it on the
first try?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Everything I struggled with was a piece
of cake
for you. You were a real model
student, too.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Maybe you would've been just fine even
without
me...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: No, no! You've got it all wrong, Kita!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I was only able to do things so well
because you
showed me how to do them
first.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
You've always thrown yourself headfirst
into
things, just to show me the way.
Even when things
didn't work out, you'd
still teach me what I
needed to do.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
That's not a failure. You might think you
failed,
Kita, but "we" certainly haven't.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
We've always marched on with you in
the front
and me following behind you,
and look how far
we've come.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Dia...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I look up at the night sky and
see the
Milky Way twinkling above me,
it occurs to me...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I realize we're both in the same boat,
riding along
the same river, and heading
toward the same goal
together.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
The two of us are different in so many
ways, but
deep down in our heart of
hearts, we are more
alike than anyone
else...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Even though we aren't sisters by blood,
we're
truer sisters than anyone else out
there.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Truer sisters than anyone else...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
You're right. I've always felt your joy and
pain as
if they were my own.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Nobody has a stronger connection than
ours!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Exactly I feel all your feelings as if they
were mine
too.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Here we are, true sisters in all but blood,
pushing
one another to greater heights
as we advance
down the river...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
You know what, Dia? When it's time for
the Arima
Kinen, let's enter the gates
with our hearts as one!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Let's walk in, just like we did when we
stepped
past Tracen's gates on the first
day of school, and
vow not to lose to
each other!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes. We'll enter the race with our hearts
united,
just as they've always been, and
always will be...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Their friendship is as vast and deep as
the Milky
Way itself, and the current of
their love is ever
connected in the
depths of their hearts.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even if their stream diverges, they will
always
converge once more. And when
they clash at the
Arima Kinen, they will
become one.
